scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers for the dual-pair dichotomy; finite thick generalized quadrangles for the universal linewise partition; point and line sorts distinguished; verification programs cover prime fields, not arbitrary extension fields. title: Two-point counting-logic dichotomy for dual symplectic quadrangles
